subject: Tandem pilot: request for remedial credit due to prefetch gap
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <procurement@tandemsys.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@tandemsys.com
Date: Mon, 3 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot impact: request for credit given missing prefetch support

Hi Logan / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last month — the Tandem pilot is running but we hit a significant blocker: our dataset and UX rely heavily on server-side prefetch/prefix caching to keep latency acceptable. The model variant that shipped to our pilot environment does not support the prefetch hooks we were sold on and the engineering effort to shim around it will take our team ~6-8 weeks.

This delay materially increases expected token spend and degrades the user experience for our beta cohort. Procurement/legal asked me to request a remedial commercial concession while the engineering fix is delivered. Specifically: a timeboxed credit or discount to cover the incremental token spend and to offset the engagement risk for our pilot cohort.

Attached is a short summary (prefetch_issue_summary.xlsx) showing the latency and cost delta across our sample flows. We want to keep moving forward with Redwood, but we need a commercial accommodation to make the pilot viable. Can you advise next steps and whether Redwood can provide a temporary credit while the product fix is prioritized?

Best,
Maria Lopez
Procurement Lead | Tandem Systems
procurement@tandemsys.com

Attachment: prefetch_issue_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28 KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <procurement@tandemsys.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Jun 2028 14:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot impact: request for credit given missing prefetch support

Hi Maria — thank you for the clear summary and the spreadsheet, that helped.

Short answer: we want Tandem to succeed and we can offer a temporary concession while our product team ships the prefetch hooks. I need to get executive sign-off for anything outside standard goodwill thresholds (this request looks like it will). Laura / Marcus — TL;DR below and ask for help aligning on exact commercial terms and how we track it.

Proposal (ops recommendation):
- One-time credit equal to the estimated incremental token spend capped at $60k OR
- 20% usage credit for the first 3 months of the pilot (whichever is lower)

Key asks for procurement: a short mutual action plan that lists the prefetch milestones and a commitment to the pilot rollout cadence so we can map the credit to observed spend.

Maria, I attached the latest Tandem MA that Legal shared (Tandem_MA_2028-05-31.pdf) so internal teams can see scope. Laura / Marcus — can you review and advise if that commercial approach is acceptable? If so I'll send an exec approval note to Karthik for sign-off.

Thanks,
Logan
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

Attachment: Tandem_MA_2028-05-31.pdf (PDF, 92 KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Lopez <procurement@tandemsys.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Jun 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot impact: request for credit — exec approval requested (DEAL-99821)

Karthik / Marcus / Laura — forwarding Tandem's request and my suggested remediation. This is time-sensitive: Tandem has an active beta cohort and their go/no-go depends on a short-term commercial accommodation.

Summary: prefetch/prefix KV hooks are missing in the shipped variant; engineering estimates 6-8 weeks to fully deliver. Tandem asks for a remedial commercial concession to make the pilot cost-neutral while we ship the fix.

Recommended concession (pick one):
A) One-time credit capped at $60,000 to cover incremental spend (preferred from an accounting simplicity perspective)
B) 20% usage credit for first 3 months post-pilot launch (operationally heavier)

Why approve: preserves a strategic mid-market reference account, prevents churn during pilot, aligns with our product roadmap (prefetch is already prioritized). Tracking: Finance will record credits against DEAL-99821 and we will attach milestone gates in the MAP (deliverables and ETA).

If you approve, please reply to this thread with the approved option and any edit to the cap/term. I'm happy to draft the concession language for Legal and Ops to finalize.

Thanks for the concise summary, Logan. I agree we should preserve momentum with Tandem. I approve option A with a minor tweak: set the cap at $50,000 instead of $60,000, and require two milestone checkpoints (engineering smoke test + pilot revalidation) before the credit is posted. Please coordinate with Finance to 1) tag the credit to DEAL-99821, 2) create a memo for internal audit, and 3) capture MAP milestones in the customer folder.

Logan — please confirm you will prepare the concession language for Legal and send the MAP updates to Maria. Marcus / Laura — help track the milestone gating.
